source_registry.role: R17 terminal attempt ledger through E1-B negative-control HOLD; these institutional assets are only the cross-project reusable policy projection

final_visible_budget_asset.reusable_precheck: Before declaring evidence/token budgets matched, measure the exact representation visible to the model after decoding, concatenation, wrappers, truncation and re-tokenization. Freeze the final renderer/tokenizer and verify parity on the final model-visible text, not on upstream token slices.
final_visible_budget_asset.does_not_imply: scientific-mechanism failure; the failed run did not reach a valid effectiveness endpoint

reuse_scope.applies_to: LLM/VLM evidence matching and any transformed model input

causal_provenance_asset.reusable_precheck: For same-object causal interventions, trace the exact model-visible dataflow. Keep arm labels, projection names, rollout IDs, file paths, provider IDs, content hashes and acting provenance outside model-visible treatment unless explicitly predeclared as treatment. Bind outcome labels to the selected evidence rather than to a different served action.
causal_provenance_asset.does_not_imply: the underlying mechanism is false; the legacy path was not causally interpretable

provider_budget_asset.reusable_precheck: Before any paid/provider scientific tranche, make the call ceiling a transactional pre-I/O invariant. Persist a contract/authorization-bound ledger, claim before I/O, never release ambiguous crash claims, and test the first forbidden per-unit/global call is rejected before network I/O.
provider_budget_asset.does_not_imply: scientific failure; this is an execution-governance defect

reuse_scope.applies_to: paid APIs and long-running provider experiments

role_runtime_asset.reusable_precheck: Qualify actor/evaluator, updater/trainer and baseline harness runtimes separately. For each role bind the exact interpreter, environment/freeze hash, source-path binding and real scientific entrypoint, and execute a zero-provider/zero-outcome smoke of that entrypoint. Passing one role never authorizes another.
role_runtime_asset.does_not_imply: mechanism failure or model incapability; the intended updater procedure was not executable in the inherited actor runtime

zero_missing_asset.reusable_precheck: For scientific counters where zero is meaningful, parse missing/null explicitly and test zero, one and missing cases. Never use `value or sentinel` or generic truthiness to distinguish missingness from zero in adjudication code.
zero_missing_asset.does_not_imply: a negative scientific result; the frozen data remained valid and required a versioned re-adjudication only

reuse_scope.applies_to: scientific summaries, counters and gate adjudicators

review_layer_asset.reusable_precheck: Persist raw reviewer output before local parsing. Version the schema separately, validate acknowledgement fields declared by the active schema rather than hard-coding historical names, and when raw content is complete prefer zero-provider reparsing over regenerating reviewer calls.
review_layer_asset.does_not_imply: reviewer disagreement or scientific rejection; local parser failure must not erase valid raw model content

execution_faithful_preflight_asset.reusable_precheck: A preflight is authoritative only if it uses the same executable, VIRTUAL_ENV/PATH, source roots, environment variables and exact entrypoint as the scientific runner. Treat a check with different bindings as diagnostic noise until reproduced faithfully.
execution_faithful_preflight_asset.does_not_imply: runtime failure or scientific failure until the execution-faithful preflight reproduces it

reuse_scope.applies_to: remote scientific runners and source-tree checkouts

duplicate_launch_asset.reusable_precheck: After timeout/502 or before relaunch, inspect the content-addressed run root, exclusive lock payload, PID state, completed-unit manifest and provider-budget ledger. Do not rely on naive full-command `pgrep` patterns that can self-match, and never interpret a transport timeout as proof the remote job stopped.
duplicate_launch_asset.does_not_imply: a scientific failure or a stopped remote experiment

negative_control_identifiability_asset.reusable_precheck: Before a causal treatment comparison on a hosted stochastic stack, run a byte-identical treatment negative control at the true independent unit and test a preregistered practical-equivalence margin. If equivalence fails, keep the mechanism sign/value unknown, block downstream causal execution, and use only zero-provider diagnostics to localize nuisance layers. Any renewed attempt must be a new versioned protocol with an independently justified single-variable intervention.
negative_control_identifiability_asset.does_not_imply: implementation failure, central-mechanism failure, or permission to relax the equivalence margin, remove noisy units, change models/probes, or rerun until favorable
